source: Authorized temporary XLSX export of the existing private lead workbook; raw source remains outside the project.
method: stdlib ZIP/XML, selected staff-operating worksheets only; values, formula presence and related-comment metadata checked

staff_guide.finding: A nominated reviewer and daily 10:00-19:00 Dubai coverage are documented. Existing consultant access, cover, measured capacity and escalation thresholds explicitly remain unverified.
150 people/day is described as an objective, not observed capacity.
Closing instructions require observed totals, evidence and the actual next owner. Unavailable counts must stay blank.
Actual access, mappings, protections, whole-history evidence and a labelled internal rehearsal are required before private bridge use. The files create no capacity or launch approval.

conclusion: The inspected workbook snapshot supplies operating instructions and blank staff tables, with no recorded completion, actual attendance/sign-off, rehearsal timings or measured-capacity evidence for the requested session.
limits: Absence is scoped to these five worksheets in this export. It does not prove the event never occurred or exclude evidence in other authorized sources. File-modification metadata was not used as absence proof.
